summary: StudentLookups is a web service endpoint in HSPnet, used to provide original student IDs for AJAX cascading dropdowns. It validates user sessions and returns a JSON list of student IDs based on supplied search parameters.
purpose: To deliver lookup capabilities for student identification within the HSPnet system, facilitating AJAX requests for cascading dropdown lists by providing original HSPnet student IDs.

entities.name: Student
entities.description: Represents a student for lookup purposes.

entities.name: Session
entities.description: Represents a user session in HSPnet.

actors.name: AJAX Toolkit
actors.description: Consumes the StudentLookups web service for populating dropdowns.

workflows.name: GetOriginalHSPnetIDs
steps: Receive lookup parameters and session hash.
Validate session using SessionIsValid stored procedure.
If session is valid, query for student list using search parameters.
Serialize student IDs to JSON format.
If session is invalid, return empty array.

business_rules: Session must be valid before returning student data.
Returned student list contains only original HSPnet IDs.
validations: Session validity checked via SessionIsValid stored procedure.
Input parameters are passed as-is without further validation in this code fragment.
conditions: If sessionValid is true, proceed with lookup; else return an empty result.
system_behavior: Provides JSON response for lookup requests.
Returns empty array if session is invalid.
dependencies: Depends on HSPnetSession methods for session handling and database access.
Depends on Students.OriginalHSPnetIdList for student data retrieval.
Depends on AJAX Toolkit for client interaction.
exceptions: Session invalidation results in no data returned to client.
content_gaps: No details on full student entity structure beyond ID.
No information on error handling if database or session services fail.
No explicit validation or sanitization of input parameters.
